description: This Java class defines a command to modify Resources within a policy framework, specifically for Eclipse Ditto policies. It includes methods for creating, serializing, and deserializing the command, and manages policy identifiers, labels, and resource data.

classes.name: ModifyResources
classes.description: Final class representing a command to modify resources associated with a specific policy and label, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, with various accessor methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a ModifyResources command from policy ID, label, resources, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to deserialize a JSON string or object into a ModifyResources command.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry to be modified.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Returns the Resources object to be used in the modification.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId of the target policy.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the Resources as a JsonValue for the specified schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource within the policy structure.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command payload to a JsonObjectBuilder, respecting the schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ModifyResources with updated DittoHeaders.
